spl_product_data_elements: Kids Oral Care Strawberry Flavor Xylitol, Calcium Lactate SODIUM ANISATE CALCIUM LACTATE CALCIUM CATION XYLITOL XYLITOL SODIUM LEVULINATE SODIUM CHLORIDE CALCIUM OXIDE GLYCERIN WATER SILICA DICALCIUM PHOSPHATE TREHALOSE
inactive_ingredient: Inactive ingredients: Water, Glycerin, Sodium Levulinate, Sodium Anisate, Trehalose, Sodium Chloride, Dicalcium Phosphate, Silica, Calcium Oxide
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: keep out of reach of children: For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoidcontact with eyes. Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur.
indications_and_usage: Helps protect against cavities. Spray 2 to 3 times towards children's teeth to prevent plaque build up and cavities.
warnings: Warnings: Avoid spraying in eyes. In case of contact, rinse eyes thoroughly with water. Stop use and ask a doctor or pharmacist if you have an allergic reaction to this product or any of its ingredients.
dosage_and_administration: Directions: Apply the spray on the kiddo's teeth surface to form a protective coating.Do not spit the spray out.Do not rinse with water after spray. This spray is not intend to replace brushing or flossing.
other_safety_information: Other: Store at 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F) Use product within 90 days of opening.
